name: 和風
uniqueCss: .center-mon { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 140px; height: 140px; z-index: 10; }

.mon-outer { position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8b4513, #a0522d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #dcb464, 0 0 30px rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.5), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }

.mon-inner { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 85%; height: 85%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #2a1810 0%, #1a0f0a 100%); border: 2px solid #dcb464; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); }
.mon-symbol { font-size: 48px; color: #dcb464; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.8); animation: mon-glow 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
.pointer { top: -25px; border-left: 25px solid transparent; border-right: 25px solid transparent; border-top: 45px solid #c41e3a; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(196, 30, 58, 0.6)); }

.pointer::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -45px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 12px; height: 12px; background: #dcb464; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.8); }

.button { padding: 20px 80px; font-size: 28px; color: #ffffff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8b4513 0%, #a0522d 50%, #8b4513 100%); border: 3px solid #dcb464; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #5a2d0f; }
